aarch64.abi_scope: AAPCS64 base PCS; platform and SVE/SME variants require their own preservation rules

partial_callee_saved.note: upper halves of corresponding Q/Z registers are not preserved by the base PCS

allocation.alias_write: W-register definitions zero the upper 32 bits of the corresponding X register

riscv.abi_scope: standard full-register ILP32/LP64 ABI families; excludes ILP32E

allocation.floating_preservation: fs0-fs11 are preserved only for values no wider than ABI_FLEN under a hardware FP ABI; base integer ABI preserves no FP registers
allocation.vector_preservation: standard ABI clobbers v0-v31; vector_cc preserves v1-v7 and v24-v31
allocation.vector_group_constraint: LMUL register groups begin at a register number divisible by max(1, LMUL); tuple groups are consecutive

allocation.byte_write: register-direct byte results clear the upper byte; GR8 and GR16 views interfere

selection.two_address: honor Constraints ties between src2 and rd; insert/coalesce copies before selection
selection.flags: SR defs serialize comparisons and arithmetic; ADDC/SUBC also consume carry
selection.frame_address: ADDframe expands to MOV16rr plus ADD16ri/SUB16ri when offset is nonzero

scheduling.timing_status: LLVM target supplies no complete cycle/resource model; timing depends on addressing mode and device memory waits
hazards: preserve SP and memory ordering across calls, push/pop and returns
do not treat unresolved mayLoad/mayStore/hasSideEffects as false

selection.large_spill_offsets: materialize offset and scavenge GRRegs scratch registers
selection.custom_encoding: 3r/2rus ALU forms have unresolved operand bits in TableGen; use LLVM's custom packing rather than assuming ordinary bitfields

scheduling.timing_status: LLVM target has no complete per-instruction cycle/resource model
hazards: resource I/O and synchronization may block; preserve side effects
do not assign ISA-wide latencies to a hardware-multithreaded implementation

selection.c_arguments: stack by default; inreg non-vararg operands can use R6/R7/R18/R19
selection.fast_arguments: non-vararg arguments use R6/R7/R18/R19 before stack
selection.frame_offsets: signed 10 bits for SPLS or signed 16 bits for other directly addressed frame operations
selection.large_offsets: scavenge GPR; materialize using MOVHI + OR_I_LO; choose register-indexed load/store
selection.negative_alu_immediate: ALU immediates are unsigned; replace ADD with SUB and negate the offset

hazards: respect SR dependencies between flag-setting ALU operations and conditional instructions
match SchedRW/Itinerary to the selected processor model
